passages.text: Then Samuel said to all Israel, “I have listened to your voice in all that you have said to me, and I have set over you a king.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and leader of Israel.
Samuel spoke to all the people of Israel.
Samuel said, “I have listened to you.
I heard everything you said to me.
I have made a king rule over you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנֵּה֙ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי בְקֹֽלְכֶ֔ם לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לִ֑י וָאַמְלִ֥יךְ עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Now here is the king walking before you, and I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have walked before you from my youth until this day.
passages.sermon:
Samuel spoke to all Israel.
Saul is now your king.
Saul stands and leads before you.
I am Samuel.
I am old.
My hair is gray.
My sons are here with you.
I have lived among you.
I have walked before you since I was young.
I have done this until today.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה הִנֵּ֥ה הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ׀ מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֗ם וַאֲנִי֙ זָקַ֣נְתִּי וָשַׂ֔בְתִּי וּבָנַ֖י הִנָּ֣ם אִתְּכֶ֑ם וַאֲנִי֙ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם מִנְּעֻרַ֖י עַד־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Here I am. Bear witness against me before the LORD and before His anointed: Whose ox or donkey have I taken? Whom have I cheated or oppressed? From whose hand have I accepted a bribe and closed my eyes? Tell me, and I will restore it to you.”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and leader of Israel.
Samuel spoke to all the people.
Samuel said, “Here I am.
Testify against me now.
Do this before the LORD.
Do this before His anointed king.
Tell me if I have taken anyone’s ox.
Tell me if I have taken anyone’s donkey.
Tell me if I have cheated anyone.
Tell me if I have oppressed anyone.
Tell me if I have accepted a bribe from anyone.
Tell me if I have closed my eyes to wrongdoing because of a bribe.
If I have done any of these things, I will give it back to you.”
passages.original: הִנְנִ֣י עֲנ֣וּ בִי֩ נֶ֨גֶד יְהוָ֜ה וְנֶ֣גֶד מְשִׁיח֗וֹ אֶת־ שׁוֹר֩׀ מִ֨י לָקַ֜חְתִּי וַחֲמ֧וֹר מִ֣י לָקַ֗חְתִּי וְאֶת־ מִ֤י עָשַׁ֙קְתִּי֙ אֶת־ מִ֣י רַצּ֔וֹתִי וּמִיַּד־ מִי֙ לָקַ֣חְתִּי כֹ֔פֶר וְאַעְלִ֥ים עֵינַ֖י בּ֑וֹ וְאָשִׁ֖יב לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: “You have not wronged us or oppressed us,” they replied, “nor have you taken anything from the hand of man.”
passages.sermon:
The people spoke to Samuel.
They said, “You have not wronged us.
You have not oppressed us.
You have not taken anything from anyone.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א עֲשַׁקְתָּ֖נוּ וְלֹ֣א רַצּוֹתָ֑נוּ וְלֹֽא־ לָקַ֥חְתָּ מִיַּד־ אִ֖ישׁ מְאֽוּמָה׃

passages.text: Samuel said to them, “The LORD is a witness against you, and His anointed is a witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.” “He is a witness,” they replied.
passages.sermon:
Samuel spoke to the people.
Samuel was a prophet and leader of Israel.
Samuel said, "The LORD is a witness against you."
Samuel said, "His anointed is also a witness today."
Samuel said, "You have not found anything in my hand."
The people replied, "He is a witness."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם עֵ֧ד יְהוָ֣ה בָּכֶ֗ם וְעֵ֤ד מְשִׁיחוֹ֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֧א מְצָאתֶ֛ם בְּיָדִ֖י מְא֑וּמָה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר עֵֽד׃פ

passages.text: Then Samuel said to the people, “The LORD is the One who appointed Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
Samuel spoke to the people.
Samuel was a prophet and leader in Israel.
Samuel said, "The LORD did something important."
The LORD chose Moses.
The LORD chose Aaron.
The LORD brought your fathers out of Egypt.
The LORD rescued your ancestors from slavery.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַאֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת־ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Now present yourselves, so that I may confront you before the LORD with all the righteous acts He has done for you and your fathers.
passages.sermon:
Samuel spoke to the people of Israel.
Samuel was a prophet and judge.
Samuel said, “Stand here now.”
Samuel said, “I will judge you before the LORD.”
The LORD is God.
The LORD did many righteous acts.
The LORD did these acts for you.
The LORD did these acts for your fathers.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ וְאִשָּׁפְטָ֥ה אִתְּכֶ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ צִדְק֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה אִתְּכֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: When Jacob went to Egypt, your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He sent them Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place.
passages.sermon:
Jacob went to Egypt.
Your fathers were in Egypt.
Your fathers cried out to the LORD.
The LORD heard them.
The LORD sent Moses and Aaron.
Moses and Aaron led your fathers out of Egypt.
Moses and Aaron brought your fathers to this place.
The LORD settled your fathers here.
passages.original: כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיִּזְעֲק֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיּוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֶת־ אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וַיֹּשִׁב֖וּם בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: But they forgot the LORD their God, and He sold them into the hand of Sisera the commander of the army of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines and the king of Moab, who fought against them.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites forgot the LORD.
The LORD is their God.
The LORD gave the Israelites into the power of Sisera.
Sisera was the commander of the army of Hazor.
The LORD also gave the Israelites into the power of the Philistines.
The LORD also gave the Israelites into the power of the king of Moab.
Sisera, the Philistines, and the king of Moab fought against the Israelites.
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׁכְּח֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּמְכֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֡ם בְּיַ֣ד סִֽיסְרָא֩ שַׂר־ צְבָ֨א חָצ֜וֹר וּבְיַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וּבְיַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ בָּֽם׃

passages.text: Then they cried out to the LORD and said, ‘We have sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths. Now deliver us from the hands of our enemies, that we may serve You.’
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel cried out to the LORD.
They said, “We have sinned.”
They said, “We have abandoned the LORD.”
They said, “We served the Baals.”
They said, “We served the Ashtoreths.”
They said, “Now rescue us from our enemies.”
They said, “Then we will serve You.”
passages.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֤וּ אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמֶר חָטָ֔אנוּ כִּ֤י עָזַ֙בְנוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וַנַּעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הָעַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְעַתָּ֗ה הַצִּילֵ֛נוּ מִיַּ֥ד אֹיְבֵ֖ינוּ וְנַעַבְדֶֽךָּ׃

passages.text: So the LORD sent Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah, and Samuel, and He delivered you from the hands of your enemies on every side, and you dwelt securely.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD sent leaders to help you.
He sent Jerubbaal.
He sent Barak.
He sent Jephthah.
He sent Samuel.
The LORD delivered you from your enemies.
Your enemies surrounded you.
The LORD saved you from them.
You lived in safety.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יְרֻבַּ֣עַל וְאֶת־ בְּדָ֔ן וְאֶת־ יִפְתָּ֖ח וְאֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיַּצֵּ֨ל אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִיַּ֤ד אֹֽיְבֵיכֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וַתֵּשְׁב֖וּ בֶּֽטַח׃

passages.text: But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king to rule over us’—even though the LORD your God was your king.
passages.sermon:
Nahash was the king of the Ammonites.
Nahash came to attack you.
You saw Nahash coming against you.
You spoke to me.
You said, “No, we want a king to rule over us.”
The LORD your God was your king.
You asked for a human king, even though God was already your king.
passages.original: וַתִּרְא֗וּ כִּֽי־ נָחָ֞שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּוֹן֮ בָּ֣א עֲלֵיכֶם֒ וַתֹּ֣אמְרוּ לִ֔י לֹ֕א כִּי־ מֶ֖לֶךְ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ינוּ וַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מַלְכְּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you requested. Behold, the LORD has placed a king over you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
You asked for a king.
You chose this king.
The LORD has given you a king.
The LORD has set this king over you.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּ֥ה הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁאֶלְתֶּ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: If you fear the LORD and serve Him and obey His voice, and if you do not rebel against the command of the LORD, and if both you and the king who reigns over you follow the LORD your God, then all will be well.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
You have chosen a king to rule over you.
If you fear the LORD, you will respect Him.
If you serve the LORD, you will do what He asks.
If you obey the LORD’s voice, you will listen to His words.
If you do not rebel against the LORD’s command, you will not go against Him.
If you and your king both follow the LORD your God, you will walk after Him.
If you do these things, all will be well for you.
passages.original: אִם־ תִּֽירְא֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּ֣ם בְּקֹל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א תַמְר֖וּ אֶת־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וִהְיִתֶ֣ם גַּם־ אַתֶּ֗ם וְגַם־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלַ֣ךְ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אַחַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But if you disobey the LORD and rebel against His command, then the hand of the LORD will be against you as it was against your fathers.
passages.sermon:
If you do not obey the LORD,
and if you rebel against His command,
then the LORD will act against you.
The LORD will also act against your fathers, just as He did before.
passages.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וּמְרִיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֧ה יַד־ יְהוָ֛ה בָּכֶ֖ם וּבַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Now, therefore, stand and see this great thing that the LORD will do before your eyes.
passages.sermon:
Samuel spoke to the people of Israel.
Samuel was a prophet of the LORD.
He said, “Now stand here.
Look and see this great thing.
The LORD will do it before your eyes.”
passages.original: גַּם־ עַתָּה֙ הִתְיַצְּב֣וּ וּרְא֔וּ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עֹשֶׂ֖ה לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Is it not the wheat harvest today? I will call on the LORD to send thunder and rain, so that you will know and see what a great evil you have committed in the sight of the LORD by asking for a king.”
passages.sermon:
Today is the time of the wheat harvest.
The wheat harvest is usually dry.
I am Samuel, the prophet of the LORD.
I will call to the LORD now.
The LORD will send thunder and rain.
You will see this miracle with your own eyes.
You will know that you have done great evil.
You did this evil by asking for a king.
You did this evil in the sight of the LORD.
passages.original: הֲל֤וֹא קְצִיר־ חִטִּים֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֶקְרָא֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְיִתֵּ֥ן קֹל֖וֹת וּמָטָ֑ר וּדְע֣וּ וּרְא֗וּ כִּֽי־ רָעַתְכֶ֤ם רַבָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲשִׂיתֶם֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לִשְׁא֥וֹל לָכֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ׃ס

passages.text: So Samuel called to the LORD, and on that day the LORD sent thunder and rain. As a result, all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of God.
Samuel called to the LORD.
The LORD sent thunder and rain that day.
All the people saw what happened.
The people greatly feared the LORD.
The people also greatly feared Samuel.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה קֹלֹ֥ת וּמָטָ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּירָ֨א כָל־ הָעָ֥ם מְאֹ֛ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃

passages.text: They pleaded with Samuel, “Pray to the LORD your God for your servants so that we will not die! For we have added to all our sins the evil of asking for a king.”
passages.sermon:
All the people spoke to Samuel.
They said, "Pray for your servants."
They asked Samuel to pray to the LORD, Samuel’s God.
They said, "Pray so that we will not die."
They said, "We have added evil to all our sins."
They said, "We did wrong by asking for a king."
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ כָל־ הָעָ֜ם אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל הִתְפַּלֵּ֧ל בְּעַד־ עֲבָדֶ֛יךָ אֶל־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וְאַל־ נָמ֑וּת כִּֽי־ יָסַ֤פְנוּ עַל־ כָּל־ חַטֹּאתֵ֙ינוּ֙ רָעָ֔ה לִשְׁאֹ֥ל לָ֖נוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃ס

passages.text: “Do not be afraid,” Samuel replied. “Even though you have committed all this evil, do not turn aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of the LORD.
Samuel spoke to the people.
Samuel said, "Do not be afraid.
You have done all this evil.
But do not turn aside from following the LORD.
Serve the LORD with all your heart."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל־ הָעָם֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֔אוּ אַתֶּ֣ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את אַ֗ךְ אַל־ תָּס֙וּרוּ֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Do not turn aside after worthless things that cannot profit you or deliver you, for they are empty.
passages.sermon:
Do not turn aside.
Do not follow worthless things.
Worthless things cannot help you.
Worthless things cannot save you.
These things are empty.
passages.original: וְלֹ֖א תָּס֑וּרוּ כִּ֣י׀ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַתֹּ֗הוּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יוֹעִ֛ילוּ וְלֹ֥א יַצִּ֖ילוּ כִּי־ תֹ֥הוּ הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: Indeed, for the sake of His great name, the LORD will not abandon His people, because He was pleased to make you His own.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has a great name.
The LORD chose you to be His people.
The LORD was pleased to make you His own people.
The LORD will not abandon His people.
The LORD will not leave you, because of His great name.
passages.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ יִטֹּ֤שׁ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר שְׁמ֣וֹ הַגָּד֑וֹל כִּ֚י הוֹאִ֣יל יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֶתְכֶ֛ם ל֖וֹ לְעָֽם׃

passages.text: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD by ceasing to pray for you. And I will continue to teach you the good and right way.
passages.sermon:
I am Samuel.
I am a prophet of the LORD.
I will not stop praying for you.
If I stopped praying for you, I would sin against the LORD.
I will keep teaching you.
I will show you the good way.
I will show you the right way.
passages.original: גַּ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י חָלִ֤ילָה לִּי֙ מֵחֲטֹ֣א לַֽיהוָ֔ה מֵחֲדֹ֖ל לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעַדְכֶ֑ם וְהוֹרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה וְהַיְשָׁרָֽה׃

passages.text: Above all, fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things He has done for you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is powerful and holy.
You must fear the LORD.
You must serve the LORD.
Serve Him with all your heart.
Serve Him faithfully.
Remember what the LORD has done for you.
He has done great things for you.
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ יְר֣אוּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֛וֹ בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י רְא֔וּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ הִגְדִּ֖ל עִמָּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away.”
passages.sermon: If you keep doing evil, you will be destroyed.\r\nYour king will also be destroyed.\r\nGod will sweep away both you and your king.
passages.original: וְאִם־ הָרֵ֖עַ תָּרֵ֑עוּ גַּם־ אַתֶּ֥ם גַּֽם־ מַלְכְּכֶ֖ם תִּסָּפֽוּ׃פ
